name: sql-valid8
description: Multi-dialect SQL best practices analyzer for MSSQL (SQL Server 2019+), PostgreSQL (13+), Oracle (19c+), MySQL (8.0+), and SQLite. Reviews stored procedures, queries, and application code (Python, Node.js, C#) for performance issues, SQL injection, missing indexes, connection pooling, error handling, and 52 static analysis rules. Auto-detects dialect from code context. Includes CLI analyzer with --fix suggestions for CI/CD pipelines, inline suppression pragmas (-- sql-valid8:ignore), a GitHub Actions CI gate template, pre-commit git hook for local SQL validation before commit (auto-detects dialect, blocks CRITICAL findings), database audit scripts, slow query diagnostics, and index recommendation queries for each platform.
